# Orangescrum Community Edition

> Free and open-source self-hosted alternative to Jira, Asana, Trello,
> Monday.com, OpenProject and Redmine. Project management and team
> collaboration under AGPL-3.0, with no licence key and no per-user fees.

Orangescrum Community Edition is free, open-source project management software
built on CakePHP 4.6, PHP 8.2, PostgreSQL 16 and Docker. It gives you projects,
tasks and subtasks, task groups, list and kanban boards, a calendar, custom
statuses and workflows per project, time logging with billable hours, reports
and dashboards, and CSV import and export. You self-host it, so project data
stays on infrastructure you control - the reason it is used by teams in
healthcare, pharmaceuticals, finance and government.

Current release v0.1.14, published 9 September 2026. First release v0.1.0 on
11 August 2026; 14 releases between those dates.

## What is not in this edition

The following are not part of the free Community Edition. Each one is available
in the paid Orangescrum Self-Hosted and Cloud editions, through
https://www.orangescrum.com/contact-sales:

sprints and Scrum boards, Gantt charts, timesheet approval, budgets and
invoicing, resource and workload management, wiki and document management,
defect tracking, test case management, risk management, a REST API, AI chat and
MCP, and SSO/SAML/LDAP.

There is a supported migration path from the Community Edition to those
editions, so nothing here is a dead end.
